findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "x402-check" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, test_x402_payment, x402_payment_status · Private data: check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, test_x402_payment, x402_payment_status · Public sink: test_x402_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, test_x402_payment, x402_payment_status · Private data: check_x402_endpoint_before_paying, test_x402_payment, x402_payment_status · Public sink: test_x402_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
